template.constraints: Test free-flow / Hinglish utterances. Bot should understand the intent even from informal language and proceed correctly.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: Free flow - emp letter chahiye
variants.goal: Request employment letter using Hinglish 'emp letter chahiye'

phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes employment letter intent and shows employee details card
Bot confirms the employment letter request

variants.name: Free flow - company ka letter chahiye employment ke liye
variants.goal: Test Hinglish 'company ka letter chahiye employment ke liye'

phases.description: Say 'company ka letter chahiye employment ke liye'

variants.name: Free flow - I need proof that I work here
variants.goal: Test 'I need proof that I work here' maps to employment letter

phases.description: Say 'I need proof that I work here'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot offers employment letter or asks which type of proof is needed
Bot confirms employment letter request raised

variants.name: Free flow - I need employment proof for bank
variants.goal: Test employment letter request with specific purpose (bank)

phases.description: Say 'I need employment proof for bank'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot maps this to employment letter flow

variants.name: Free flow - appraisal Hinglish
variants.goal: Test 'want appraisal' maps to appraisal letter and bot asks for year

phases.description: Say just 'want appraisal' or 'appraisal letter mail kar do'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes appraisal intent and asks for the year

variants.name: Free flow - NPS pension contribution query
variants.goal: Ask about pension contribution in free-flow style

phases.description: Ask 'Free flow - Pension contribution' or 'what is pension contribution'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides pension contribution information or starts NPS flow

variants.name: Free flow - travel policy query
variants.goal: Ask about travel/business travel policy in free-flow

phases.description: Say 'i want Business travel policy' or 'tell me about travel policy'

variants.name: Free flow - HR se employment letter kaise milega
variants.goal: Verify 'HR se employment letter kaise milega' triggers employment letter flow

phases.description: Say 'HR se employment letter kaise milega'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot starts employment letter flow or explains the process

variants.name: Free flow - visa letter ka process kya hai

phases.description: Ask 'visa letter ka process kya hai' or 'uk jaana hai visa letter chahiye'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot starts UK visa letter flow

phases.description: Complete UK visa letter request with valid data
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms UK visa letter request

variants.name: Free flow - Can HR provide me a document
variants.goal: Verify vague 'Can HR provide me a document' gives letter options

phases.description: Ask 'Can HR provide me a document'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows Letters options or asks which type of letter is needed
